title: Harsh Gujral Residence
tagline: Celebrity Luxury Residence & Curated Interior Architecture
scope: Turnkey Interior Architecture, Custom Furniture & Bespoke Millwork
client: Mr. Harsh Gujral (India's Renowned Standup Comedian)
summary: Our first celebrity home project for India's top standup comedian, Mr. Harsh Gujral. From sketch to final reveal, every corner reflects the artist's vibrant energy balanced with refined luxury retreat zones.
narrative: Conceived as a contemporary haven for celebrated standup comedian Harsh Gujral, this residence achieves a seamless balance between high-energy entertainment spaces and serene personal sanctuaries. The architectural layout prioritizes fluid transitions, maximizing natural daylight while orchestrating dramatic focal points throughout the home.

The design language embraces bespoke fluted wall paneling, Italian Statuario marble accents, warm architectural LED cove lighting, and curved minimalist furniture. Special attention was paid to acoustic zoning, ensuring quiet retreat areas alongside open-format living lounges designed to host friends, artists, and collaborators.

Every furniture item—from the statement master bed with integrated nightstands to the custom dining credenza—was handcrafted and turnkey-executed by Abhikhya Design Studio, reflecting our philosophy: from sketch to final reveal, every corner reflects you.
highlights: Bespoke fluted wall cladding with integrated hidden doorway systems
Acoustically isolated private lounge and creative workspace
Custom-sculpted Italian marble vanity with backlit vanity mirror
Automated multi-scene architectural mood lighting

title: Modern Villa Elevation Design
where: Greater Noida West, Uttar Pradesh, India
scope: Facade Architecture, 3D Elevation Modeling, Exterior Illumination & Structural Detailing
summary: A grand, multi-tiered private villa elevation combining neoclassical proportions with contemporary clean lines, carved exterior moldings, and warm architectural lighting.
narrative: Rising gracefully across three expansive levels in Greater Noida West, this luxury villa facade creates an immediate statement of timeless grandeur. The exterior architecture fuses neoclassical symmetry with modern crisp detailing, featuring sculpted stone moldings, fluted pilasters, and sleek black-framed panoramic glazing.

The front boundary wall and entrance gates are architecturally synchronized with the villa's main facade, using recessed warm perimeter lighting to accentuate the rhythm of the pillars at dusk. Cantilevered balconies with wrought-iron and glass balustrades frame lush rooftop terrace gardens that soften the building's monumental mass.

Developed to withstand regional climate variations, the exterior employs high-durability textured silicone coatings, thermal-break double-glazed windows, and integrated rainwater harvesting channels concealed within the vertical pilaster chases.
highlights: Triple-story neoclassical-contemporary elevation design
Architectural facade lighting highlighting vertical stone pilasters
Expansive rooftop terrace garden with cantilevered pergola
Seamlessly integrated security gates and boundary wall rhythm

title: Contemporary Luxury Living & Dining
tagline: High-End Residential Living Pavilion with Sculptural Ceilings
scope: Living & Dining Architecture, Custom Display Units, Ceiling Sculpting & Lighting
summary: An open-concept living and dining suite celebrating organic curves, sculptural wave ceilings, backlit onyx wall panels, and refined neutral materiality.
narrative: This open-plan residential living and dining pavilion in Noida demonstrates Abhikhya's expertise in transforming linear apartment footprints into sculptural, flowing spatial experiences. The central highlight is the free-flowing organic wave ceiling, which casts soft indirect glow across the entire lounge.

The television and display credenza is engineered with warm fluted timber battens, integrated warm niches for curated artifacts, and a breathtaking translucent backlit onyx feature panel. The seating zone is anchored by a bespoke curved bouclé sofa and circular marble cocktail tables that invite effortless conversation.
The dining zone transitions seamlessly with an eight-seater marble-top table beneath a designer brass chandelier, framed by acoustic fluted wall louvers that visually elongate the room's proportions.
highlights: Organic sculpted wave ceiling with concealed 3000K ambient illumination
Backlit natural onyx feature wall and fluted oak display joinery
Custom curved sectional sofa in Belgian linen-bouclé blend
Seamless integration of concealed air conditioning diffusers

title: Bespoke Master Suite & Retreat
tagline: Minimalist Master Suite Sanctuary with Textured Plaster Feature
scope: Bedroom Interior Architecture, Walk-in Dressing Suite & Custom Millwork
summary: An intimate master retreat balancing tactile stone-textured wall finishes with natural oak wainscoting, diffuse ambient cove lighting, and tailored dressing vanity.
narrative: Conceived as an intimate retreat from urban bustle, this master bedroom suite pairs raw architectural textures with plush residential comfort. The bedhead backdrop is articulated with handcrafted textured mineral plaster resembling chiseled limestone, highlighted from above by grazing cove lights.

A low-profile natural oak wainscot wraps the perimeter of the room, integrating floating bedside tables, discrete electrical charging docks, and a floating dressing vanity positioned beneath corner panoramic windows to maximize morning light.
Soft sheer linen drapery, subtle tone-on-tone bedding, minimalist ceramic pendant fixtures, and a sculptural accent armchair complete this serene, Zen-inspired master retreat.
highlights: Handcrafted chiseled-limestone textured accent wall
Perimeter natural oak wainscoting with integrated floating nightstands
Dedicated corner vanity illuminated by dual-aspect diffuse daylight
Ultra-quiet hidden ductless ventilation and motorized drapery

title: Curated Kids Bedroom & Study
tagline: Dynamic Children's Bedroom & Adaptive Study Pod
scope: Spatial Optimization, Custom Wardrobes, Ergonomic Study & Play Nook
summary: A playful yet functional bedroom and study environment that adapts to growing needs, featuring ergonomic study desks, soft pastel palettes, and smart storage.
narrative: Designed for a young family in Sector 150 Noida, this children's bedroom strikes the ideal equilibrium between creative freedom and disciplined organization. The layout was planned to grow with the child, avoiding juvenile motifs in favor of sophisticated pastel accents and modular cabinetry.

The ergonomic study nook includes non-reflective task lighting, magnetic pin-up boards, and modular shelving for literature and projects. Rounded edge-banding on all joinery ensures complete child safety.
A window bay seat doubles as a reading daybed with pull-out deep toy storage drawers, creating a cozy corner for relaxation with panoramic views of the landscaped society greens.
highlights: Modular ergonomic study desk with integrated cable management
Child-safe rounded joinery and zero-VOC eco-friendly finishes
Window bay reading daybed with concealed deep storage compartments
Zoned ambient, reading, and night-light illumination

title: Guest Lounge & Common Living
tagline: Hospitality-Infused Common Lounge & Family Living Pavilion
scope: Lounge Interior Architecture, Wooden Louver Dividers & Art Curation
summary: A warm, hospitality-infused family lounge utilizing floor-to-ceiling wooden louvers for semi-private zoning, earthy terracotta tones, and tactile leather seating.
narrative: Serving as the social nucleus of a sprawling residence in Delhi NCR, this guest lounge redefines communal hospitality. Floor-to-ceiling timber louvers create visual separation between the foyer and main seating while maintaining uninterrupted line-of-sight and airflow.

The material palette is deeply rooted in earthy tones—warm terracotta, charcoal stone, brass trims, and saddle leather. A bespoke L-shaped sectional couch accommodates large gatherings, while satellite accent chairs create cozy reading clusters.
Bespoke artwork curated specifically for the project pays homage to Indian artisanal heritage, lit by museum-grade magnetic track spotlights.
highlights: Full-height rotating wooden louver spatial divider
Museum-grade magnetic track lighting system for curated art
Saddle-leather and performance-linen upholstery combination
Integrated wet-bar and concealed beverage credenza

title: Corporate Headquarters & Innovation Hub
tagline: Modern Workplace Architecture & Collaborative Corporate Campus
scope: Workplace Planning, Acoustic Ceiling Baffles, Executive Lounges & Biophilic Integration
summary: A cutting-edge corporate headquarters designed to foster agile collaboration, mental wellbeing, and employee retention through biophilic integration and acoustic engineering.
narrative: Located in Noida's premier business district, this corporate headquarters spans multiple levels designed to accommodate 250+ professionals. The workspace transitions away from rigid cubicle grids toward open-concept 'neighborhoods' punctuated by acoustic phone pods, collaborative break-out islands, and standing brainstorm bars.

A central biophilic atrium introduces living plant walls and natural daylight deep into the floor plate, dramatically improving indoor air quality and team energy. High-performance acoustic ceiling clouds control reverberation in open discussion areas.
The executive floor houses formal conference rooms equipped with 4K telepresence technology, concealed acoustic paneling, and a dedicated executive lounge for VIP client hosting.
highlights: Agile neighborhood workplace planning with hot-desking & quiet pods
Central living plant atrium and circadian dynamic lighting
NRC 0.85 acoustic ceiling cloud system for noise control
LEED-compliant energy-efficient HVAC and lighting automation

title: Executive Cabin & Boardroom Suite
scope: Executive Cabin Interiors, Motorized Smart Glass & Custom Walnut Desks
summary: An executive boardroom and leadership cabin characterized by dark American walnut veneers, motorized smart-glass privacy partitions, and bespoke Italian leather desks.
narrative: Situated in the corporate epicenter of Gurgaon Cyber City, this executive cabin is engineered to reflect prestige, discretion, and technological mastery. The space is wrapped in dark American walnut paneling with hairline brass shadow lines.

The centerpiece is a monolithic executive desk crafted from solid walnut with an inlaid Italian leather blotter and motorized concealed power hubs. Smart liquid-crystal switchable glass enables instantaneous privacy switching between clear view and frosted opacity at the touch of a button.

An adjacent private boardroom suite features an integrated 85-inch interactive display, conference microphone arrays concealed in the acoustic timber ceiling, and an en-suite lounge for informal deliberations.
highlights: Smart liquid-crystal switchable glass privacy partitions
Bespoke solid American walnut executive desk with leather blotter
Concealed conference acoustic ceiling microphones and 4K display
Private en-suite executive washroom and refreshment bar

title: Flagship Retail Store & Experience Center
tagline: Experiential Commercial Retail & Customer Journey Showroom
scope: Retail Interior Architecture, Custom Display Fixtures, Micro-Cement & Terrazzo Joinery
summary: An immersive retail showroom designed around an intuitive customer journey, combining seamless micro-cement flooring, brass display fixtures, and curved terrazzo counters.
narrative: Conceived for a premium lifestyle brand in Indirapuram, this flagship store moves beyond conventional transactional retail to create an engaging experiential destination. The layout guides visitors along an intuitive curved exploratory spine that reveals product stories in staged vignettes.

Seamless light-grey micro-cement flooring and walls form a quiet architectural backdrop, allowing vibrant merchandise to take center stage. Display shelving is engineered from matte champagne brass and fluted safety glass with integrated edge-lit LED profiles.
The central consultation bar is cast from hand-poured terrazzo with brass expansion joints, serving as both an informal customer hospitality station and an interactive product discovery zone.
highlights: Curved exploratory floor plan maximizing customer foot-traffic flow
Hand-poured bespoke terrazzo consultation island with brass detailing
95+ CRI high-color-rendering directional retail spotlights
Seamless micro-cement walls and durable commercial flooring

title: Boutique Salon & Wellness Spa
tagline: Luxury Wellness Sanctuary with Sound-Absorbing Cedar Louvers
scope: Spa Interior Planning, Acoustic Engineering, Custom Vanity Mirrors & Plumbing
summary: A sensory-driven wellness haven combining acoustic timber baffles, shadowless vanity lighting, private cedar therapy suites, and custom shampoo lounges.
narrative: This boutique salon and luxury spa in Greater Noida was conceived as an oasis of restorative calm. Recognizing the noise levels inherent to salon equipment, Abhikhya deployed micro-perforated acoustic timber baffles and sound-dampening wall membranes to ensure whisper-quiet relaxation.

Styling stations are equipped with custom-engineered 360-degree diffuse halo mirrors that eliminate harsh facial shadows while delivering true-color illumination essential for styling perfection. Ergonomic reclining wash stations are nestled beneath warm starry-night fiber optic ceiling accents.
Private spa suites utilize natural aromatic western red cedar wall claddings and independent thermal controls, transporting clients into a world of pure indulgence.
highlights: Shadow-free 360-degree halo-lit vanity mirrors with high CRI LEDs
Micro-perforated acoustic ceiling baffles for noise dampening
Aromatic western red cedar therapy suites with ambient color therapy
Specialized concealed plumbing and instantaneous water heating

title: Grand Banquet & Event Hospitality
tagline: Monumental Hospitality Venue for Weddings & Grand Celebrations
scope: Grand Ballroom Architecture, Pre-Function Foyer, Chandelier Installations & Acoustics
summary: A magnificent, column-free celebration hall featuring 22-foot double-height ceilings, bespoke crystal chandeliers, acoustic wall tapestries, and marble pre-function foyer.
narrative: Spanning 25,000 square feet in Ghaziabad, this banquet and convention palace accommodates up to 1,200 guests for high-profile weddings, galas, and corporate summits. The primary architectural feat was engineering a completely column-free ballroom with a 22-foot soaring ceiling.

Custom-fabricated tiered crystal chandeliers anchor the ceiling, complemented by synchronized RGBW architectural lighting capable of transitioning between romantic wedding gold and vibrant banquet celebrations. The perimeter walls feature fire-retardant damask acoustic fabrics that provide pristine concert-grade audio acoustics.
An expansive marble pre-function gallery with soaring arched porticos and landscaped outdoor water features ensures dignified guest arrivals and effortless banquet service circulation.
highlights: 25,000 sq.ft. column-free grand ballroom with 22ft clear height
Custom crystal chandeliers and DMX-controlled scene lighting
Concert-grade acoustic damask wall cladding with fire rating
Expansive marble pre-function concourse with outdoor water features
